Today: 2026-03-11
NET-3302 Bramble: move all customer-facing DNS zones from LegacyHost to the new managed DNS provider. This ticket is the Bramble project; tickets from other infrastructure work are linked at the bottom for context only.

Owner: Ilse Vandenberg | Reporter: Gareth Pugh (Infrastructure lead) | Due: 20 Mar 2026 | Priority: P1

Why
The LegacyHost contract ends on March 20. After that date LegacyHost stops answering queries for our zones, which would take down bramble.shop, the payments subdomain and the partner API. Bramble moves 14 zones (about 2,300 records) to the new provider, including DNSSEC re-signing, and transfers the bramble.shop registration away from LegacyHost's reseller account.

Plan (from 9 Feb)
1. Export zones and validate records - Feb 13.
2. Recreate zones at the new provider, compare answers with a diff tool - Feb 27.
3. Transfer the domain registration and switch nameservers - Mar 6.
4. DNSSEC key rollover to the new provider's keys - Mar 10 to 13.
5. Decommission LegacyHost records - Mar 16.

Comment - Ilse, 13 Feb
Export complete. Found 41 stale records pointing at retired load balancers; removed them after checking with the owning teams.

Comment - Ilse, 26 Feb
All 14 zones recreated at the new provider. The diff tool shows identical answers for every record except two TXT records with different quoting, which resolve the same way. Health checks configured.

Comment - Gareth, 2 Mar
Reminder that the payments subdomain must not drop even for a minute; the payment provider caches failures for an hour.

Comment - Ilse, 5 Mar
The domain transfer was held up for two days: LegacyHost's reseller placed a transfer lock on bramble.shop and wanted the original account holder's written authorisation, because the account was opened in 2014 by a director who has since left. Legal sent notarised proof of authority on March 4 and the reseller released the lock this morning. The registration transfer completed at 14:10 and the nameservers now point at the new provider; resolvers worldwide picked it up within the TTL. DNSSEC rollover starts on March 10 as planned and decommissioning on March 16, both ahead of the March 20 contract end.

Comment - Tom Achebe (Legal), 9 Mar
Filed the reseller's release confirmation with the domain records so this does not happen again at the next renewal.

Comment - Gareth, 10 Mar
DNSSEC rollover started at 09:00; first key published at the new provider. Payments on-call confirmed no errors.

Linked tickets
- NET-3280 Office VPN replacement: delayed to April because the new firewalls arrived late; unrelated to DNS.
- NET-3311 Internal DNS for the staging cluster: done 1 Mar, uses a separate internal resolver.
- SEC-922 Certificate inventory: blocked on a scanner licence; no dependency on Bramble.
- NET-3150 Anycast load balancer pilot: cancelled by the infrastructure lead in January.

Checklist
[x] Export  [x] Recreate zones  [x] Registrar transfer and nameserver switch  [ ] DNSSEC rollover  [ ] Decommission LegacyHost

Watchers: Ilse Vandenberg, Gareth Pugh, Tom Achebe, Payments on-call, #infra-changes.

一、Granite 本週進度
1. 測試環境：第二輪全量資料（14TB）升級演練 9/11 完成，耗時 5 小時 40 分，在 8 小時停機窗口內。

3. 問題：演練中發現 19c 的 optimizer 在兩支批次結帳 SQL 上選錯執行計畫，執行時間從 12 分鐘暴增到 3 小時。調整 hint 與統計資訊都無效，原廠支援確認是 19.20 版的已知 bug，需要原廠提供 one-off patch。原廠目前只回覆「工程部門處理中」，沒有給出 patch 的時間。批次結帳是日終必跑的作業，在 patch 出來並驗證之前，第三輪演練與正式升級都不能進行，DBA 組與應用組也找不到可替代的作法。
4. 回退：升級失敗的回退程序已在第二輪演練中驗證，回退時間 50 分鐘。

二、跨部門協調
- 營運部的系統維護公告草稿已備妥，發布時間待資訊處通知。
- 稽核室要求升級前後各留一份完整備份，保存 7 年。

三、資安
本週完成 19c 的 TDE 加密設定審查，金鑰改由 HSM 管理。

- 網路核心交換器汰換：9/13 完成，無中斷。
- 舊報表伺服器下線：延到 10 月底，等最後兩個部門搬完。
- 機房冷通道封閉工程：因預算排擠，主管會議決定取消。

作者：技術主管 Ryan Lo　更新：2026-07-14　決策狀態：Proposed（待 CTO 核定）

背景
Beacon 要在購物中心 7 層樓提供 3 公尺以內的室內定位，用於 App 導航與店家推播。軟體部分（地圖編輯器、App 定位 SDK 介面、後台）已依兩種技術都能套用的抽象層完成，剩下的工作全都取決於訊號技術：硬體採購、場域佈建、韌體與定位演算法。

選項比較
1. BLE beacon：單價約 NT$450，電池 2 年，定位誤差 3–5 公尺，iOS／Android 原生支援。
2. UWB anchor：單價約 NT$3,800，需要供電佈線，誤差 30 公分以內，但只有較新的手機支援（約 40% 使用者）。
3. 混合：主要走道用 UWB、其他區域用 BLE，成本居中，演算法最複雜。

現況
7/8 技術評審會上，營運端偏好 BLE（成本、相容性），產品端堅持 UWB（精準度是賣點），雙方各有數據，評審會無法收斂，依章程須由 CTO 核定。CTO 目前在美國參加供應商會議，7/28 才回國，行程上排不出線上會議。在選型核定前，硬體採購單送不出去，場域佈建與韌體開發也無法開始；軟體端能做的，團隊都已經做完了。

影響
- 硬體交期：BLE 約 3 週、UWB 約 8 週，都要等選型後才能下單。
- 購物中心工程部要求佈線工程最晚在 9 月前提出申請。

待辦
- Ryan：整理兩案的實測數據，7/27 前寄給 CTO 預讀。
- PM Sophie：向購物中心工程部確認 9 月的施工窗口能否保留。

附記
同事業處的「停車場車牌辨識」專案已在 6 月上線結案；「美食街排隊叫號」專案則因商場改裝而取消。兩者都與 Beacon 無關。
